projects.title: Hand Water
projects.alt: Illustrated transparent ripples and white particles on a green water surface
projects.summary: An open hand stirs a transparent water surface. A closed fist gathers the water into white particles.
projects.body:
An open hand stirs a transparent water surface. A closed fist gathers the water into white particles.

Move your hand in front of the webcam to shape the water, close it to collect a small cloud of particles, then open it again to release them.

Hand and face tracking protect the original camera image from the surrounding refraction. Camera frames are processed locally; the artwork does not record or upload video.

Open the interactive experience below in a desktop browser and allow camera access. Keep your face and one hand visible in good light. The first run downloads the recognition models. A mouse demo is available before enabling the camera.

projects.title: Manhattan Nights
projects.alt: Manhattan buildings and city streets beside the river at night
projects.summary: An explorable New York nightscape with 15 buildings, city streets, and the East River.
projects.body:
An explorable New York nightscape with 15 buildings, city streets, and the East River.

Drag to look around. Use WASD or arrow keys to move, Q/E to descend or ascend, Shift to move faster, and R to reset.

The editable project.json is included in the manhattan folder.
